error.title: Footage outside of project roots
error.description:
## Footage outside of project roots
These footage items are not stored under any AYON project root:
{invalid_footage_str}
Files kept in a local folder (Desktop, Downloads, a personal drive) cannot be reached by the render farm or by other artists. After Effects fails silently on unreachable footage, so the render produces missing frames without any error message. ### How to repair?
Copy the files into the project work area, then relink them in After Effects: right click the footage item in the Project panel and choose `Replace Footage` > `File...`.
If this is a legitimate case, untick **Validate Footage Location** on the **Context** item in the publisher and publish again.
